description: This Java class handles the command to update a datatable in the Fineract platform. It processes incoming JSON commands, extracts the datatable name from the URL, invokes the write service to perform the update, and returns a result indicating the operation's success.

classes.name: UpdateDatatableCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles commands to update datatables, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to update a datatable, retrieves datatable name from URL, invokes the write service, and returns the operation result.
